SELECT COALESCE(t.status, 0) AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM customer_info t WHERE t.customer_type = 1
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.status, 0)

SELECT COALESCE(t.owner_user, t.create_by) AS ownerUser, COALESCE(t.owner_user_name, t.create_by_name, COALESCE(t.owner_user, t.create_by)) AS ownerUserName, COUNT(*) AS customerCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.last_follow_time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neverFollowedCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.last_follow_time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) END AS neverFollowedRate FROM customer_info t WHERE t.customer_type = 1 AND COALESCE(t.owner_user, t.create_by) IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ownerUser, ownerUserName ORDER BY customerCount DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) FROM customer_info t INNER JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = t.id AND o.status = 'PAID' WHERE t.customer_type = 1

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, sl.create_time, MIN(o.pay_time)) / 24.0 AS days FROM customer_info t INNER JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = t.id AND o.status = 'PAID' AND (o.order_type IS NULL OR o.order_type = 'NORMAL') AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL INNER JOIN sale_lead sl ON sl.id = t.lead_id AND sl.deleted = 0 WHERE t.customer_type = 1
GROUP BY t.id, sl.create_time HAVING days IS NOT NULL

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, first_order.ot, csr.create_time) / 24.0 AS days FROM customer_info t INNER JOIN ( SELECT o.customer_id, MIN(o.pay_time) AS ot FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND (o.order_type IS NULL OR o.order_type = 'NORMAL') AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.customer_id ) first_order ON first_order.customer_id = t.id INNER JOIN company_service cs ON cs.customer_id = t.id AND cs.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN company_service_renew csr ON csr.company_service_id = cs.id AND csr.deleted = 0 WHERE t.customer_type = 1
HAVING days IS NOT NULL AND days >= 0
